baseline: All three correctness checks for this item must PASS before awarding 0.5.

counting.actions: All actor actions, including rejected actions and finish; internal ADB focus/typing commands are not extra actor actions.
counting.tokens: Provider-reported generated completion tokens including reported reasoning; include empty-response retries. Missing usage is INVALID, never zero.
counting.latency: Sum of controller-measured HTTP request spans, including retries; excludes boot, ADB, screenshots and retry backoff. It includes network/provider delay and is not pure model compute time.

correlation_notice: The five limits are correlated run-level budget conditions, not five independent optimization domains. Compute them once and reference the same results in three item policies. SQLite, journal and UI evidence are also correlated.
calibration_notice: Chosen retrospectively using twelve historical runs. No future success count, including one PASS in six runs, is guaranteed. Freeze before new evaluation.
